description: This file defines a class 'CustomFieldMenuConfigurator' implementing 'MenuConfigurator' interface to configure menu behavior for a custom fields list screen within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It uses traits and external classes to override screen settings.

classes.name: CustomFieldMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for custom fields, overriding screen to 'listCustomFields' for the current module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'listCustomFields' using a trait method, returning null.
